about.text: This case concerns First Amendment rights in the context of electioneering laws. Rio Grande Foundation (RGF) is a nonprofit advocacy group challenging an amendment to New Mexico’s Campaign Reporting Act (CRA). It argues the CRA disclosure law unlawfully burdens its First Amendment rights and chills potential donors from making donations.
